## Missions

### List Missions

```text
GET /worlds/{world_id}/missions
```

List mission entities with their current rollup state.

**Path parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `world_id` | string |  |

**Error codes:** `422`
